solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       ROUND(AVG(weight_kg))::integer AS avg_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;

ambiguities.phrase: the average weight of their shipments rounded to the nearest whole kilogram
ambiguities.readingChosen: Round half away from zero, which is PostgreSQL's numeric ROUND.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Round half to even, the banker's rule some reviewers expect.

notes: The average is exact before rounding, and missing weights are excluded as the ticket says. I did not check whether any sample average lands exactly on a half kilogram, so the tie rule is untested by this sample.
